emails.subject: Production report for PR #14 — the office has opinions
emails.body:
## ☠️ FULL ESCALATION, THE CTO IS IN THE THREAD

Monday, 10:31. The CTO just posted in `#incident-task-api`.

Priority list, verbatim: "1. Why is this on fire. 2. Who deployed this. 3. Fix it."

The senior engineer has gone very quiet. Someone from accounting walks past, panics, and walks back.

![This is fine.](https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6wriBanZ32aZRlUc/giphy.gif)

Here is the damage report:

❌ **Deployment** — Deployment initiated. Then the pager went off.
   Senior engineer (Slack): "I tested it locally, it worked on my machine." Their machine. Classic.
   └─ hint: config is unsafe, secrets belong in the environment, not source

❌ **Validation** — The API is 500ing on trivially bad input.
   Support: "Users are pasting emojis into the title field and the whole request dies."
   └─ hint: the error handlers exist but aren't wired into the app factory

❌ **Traffic shaping** — /tasks returned the whole table. The whole table.
   DevOps: "Why is the response body 40MB." Nobody answers.
   └─ hint: the store filters, but the route never passes the params through

❌ **Bulk export** — Finance downloaded the export and half their tasks vanished.
   Finance: "We exported after cleaning up and the deleted tasks are still in the CSV."
   └─ hint: export route needs to reflect deletes and set the right headers

❌ **Rate limiting** — Load test hit 50 rps and the service ate every single request. There is no limiter.
   Senior engineer: "I wrote a limiter." Everyone looks at the code. It rebuilds itself per request.
   └─ hint: the limiter is recreated per request, make it shared

❌ **Garbage collection** — Tasks people were actively editing started disappearing.
   Support ticket: "My task is GONE. I was editing it five minutes ago." Reproducible. Ouch.
   └─ hint: GC reaps by creation time, not last activity, check the store docstrings

❌ **Sync conflicts** — Two regions synced and the newer edit lost to the older one.
   The EU office edited a task. US overwrote it with stale data. EU is Not Pleased.
   └─ hint: later updated_at should win, ties keep local

❌ **Time hygiene** — Time comparisons are throwing TypeErrors in logs.
   3:14 AM the logs fill with naive-vs-aware datetime errors. The on-call does not sleep.
   └─ hint: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated, use datetime.now(timezone.utc)

❌ **Cache invalidation** — Deleted a task. Refreshed. Still there. Refreshed. Still there.
   Everyone starts hard-refreshing their browsers like it's 2009.
   └─ hint: writes need to invalidate the list cache

---
**Verdict: 4/26 checks green (9/9 areas failing)**

Rollback or fix forward, pick one fast. The CTO is already drafting the retro doc.

*Failures are reported as symptoms, not test names. Read the symptom, trace the code path, fix the cause, push again. The office is watching.*
